props.gloss_en: what is thunder? Shmuel: clouds in the sphere
as it says: 'the voice of Your thunder was in the sphere; lightnings lit up the world; the earth trembled and shook' (Ps 77:19)
the Rabbis: clouds that pour water into one another
as it says: 'at the sound of His giving a multitude of waters in the heavens' (Jer 10:13)
Rav Acha bar Yaakov: a powerful lightning that flashes in the cloud and breaks off pieces of hail
Rav Ashi: the clouds are hollow, and a wind comes and blows across their mouths, and it is like wind across the mouths of jars
for the lightning flashes, and the clouds rumble, and the rain comes
